items.question: Trong câu "Every run uses a throwaway copy, so nothing can break.", từ "throwaway" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every run uses a throwaway copy, so nothing can break.", what does "throwaway" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: throwaway /ˈθrəʊ.ə.weɪ/ (tính từ): dùng một lần rồi bỏ. "A throwaway copy" = bản sao dùng xong là bỏ, sửa gì cũng không ảnh hưởng bản gốc.
items.explanationEn: throwaway /ˈθrəʊ.ə.weɪ/ (adjective): used once and then discarded. "A throwaway copy" is used and discarded, so changes never touch the original.

items.question: Trong câu "The tables we lean on most:", từ "lean on" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The tables we lean on most:", what does "lean on" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: lean on /liːn ɒn/ (cụm từ): dựa vào, dùng đến nhiều. Nghĩa đen là "tựa vào"; trong công việc thường mang nghĩa "dựa vào, dùng nhiều".
items.explanationEn: lean on /liːn ɒn/ (phrase): rely on, use heavily. Literally "rest against"; at work it usually means "rely on, use a lot".

items.question: Trong câu "Those questions need a few extra tools, and a few habits that stop you from reporting a wrong number with confidence.", từ "with confidence" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Those questions need a few extra tools, and a few habits that stop you from reporting a wrong number with confidence.", what does "with confidence" (phrase) mean?
options: một cách tự tin, chắc chắn
items.explanation: with confidence /wɪð ˈkɒn.fɪ.dəns/ (cụm từ): một cách tự tin, chắc chắn. Cũng dùng trong "in confidence" (giữ bí mật), một nghĩa khác hẳn.
items.explanationEn: with confidence /wɪð ˈkɒn.fɪ.dəns/ (phrase): in a sure, self-assured way. Compare "in confidence" (in secret), a different meaning.

items.question: Trong câu "Step 4 is the one beginners skip, and it is the one managers remember when a number turns out wrong.", từ "turn out" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Step 4 is the one beginners skip, and it is the one managers remember when a number turns out wrong.", what does "turn out" (phrase) mean?
options: hóa ra là, rốt cuộc là
optionsEn: prove to be in the end
items.explanation: turn out /tɜːn aʊt/ (cụm từ): hóa ra là, rốt cuộc là. "It turns out (that)..." = hóa ra là... Cụm này có nhiều nghĩa khác như tắt đèn, sản xuất.
items.explanationEn: turn out /tɜːn aʊt/ (phrase): prove to be in the end. "It turns out (that)..." means it proves to be. Other senses: switch off, produce.

items.question: Trong câu "SQL happily returns a wrong answer to a badly worded question.", từ "worded" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "SQL happily returns a wrong answer to a badly worded question.", what does "worded" (adjective) mean?
options: được viết bằng chữ in hoa
được diễn đạt bằng lời theo một cách nào đó
optionsEn: expressed in words in a certain way
items.explanation: worded /ˈwɜː.dɪd/ (tính từ): được diễn đạt bằng lời theo một cách nào đó. Hay đi với trạng từ: "badly worded", "carefully worded".
items.explanationEn: worded /ˈwɜː.dɪd/ (adjective): expressed in words in a certain way. Often with an adverb: "badly worded", "carefully worded".

items.question: Trong câu "You can either shift the boundaries or shift the timestamp:", từ "boundary" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You can either shift the boundaries or shift the timestamp:", what does "boundary" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a limit or edge of a range
items.explanation: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (danh từ): ranh giới, mốc giới hạn. Trong lọc dữ liệu, boundary là mốc đầu/cuối của khoảng thời gian.
items.explanationEn: boundary /ˈbaʊn.dər.i/ (noun): a limit or edge of a range. In filtering, boundaries are the start and end points of a range.

items.question: Trong câu "You can either shift the boundaries or shift the timestamp:", từ "shift" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You can either shift the boundaries or shift the timestamp:", what does "shift" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: shift /ʃɪft/ (động từ): dịch chuyển, dời đi. Danh từ "shift" còn có nghĩa "ca làm việc" (night shift).
items.explanationEn: shift /ʃɪft/ (verb): move to a different position. As a noun, "shift" also means a work period (night shift).

items.question: Trong câu "Use it by default.", từ "by default" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Use it by default.", what does "by default" (phrase) mean?
options: làm mặc định, khi không có lý do khác
optionsEn: as the standard choice unless there is a reason not to
items.explanation: by default /baɪ dɪˈfɔːlt/ (cụm từ): làm mặc định, khi không có lý do khác. "Default" trong tài chính còn nghĩa là "vỡ nợ", nghĩa khác hẳn.
items.explanationEn: by default /baɪ dɪˈfɔːlt/ (phrase): as the standard choice unless there is a reason not to. In finance, "default" also means failing to repay a debt, a different sense.

items.question: Trong câu "Every query below was run on it, and every result table is the real output.", từ "output" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every query below was run on it, and every result table is the real output.", what does "output" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: output /ˈaʊt.pʊt/ (danh từ): kết quả trả ra. Ngược với "input" (đầu vào). Cũng nghĩa là sản lượng trong sản xuất.
items.explanationEn: output /ˈaʊt.pʊt/ (noun): the result produced. The opposite of "input". Also means production volume in manufacturing.

items.question: Trong câu "Thirteen payments disappeared in version A.", từ "disappear" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Thirteen payments disappeared in version A.", what does "disappear" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: vanished, could no longer be seen
items.explanation: disappear /ˌdɪs.əˈpɪər/ (động từ): biến mất, không còn thấy. Ở đây: các dòng dữ liệu bị lọc mất mà không báo lỗi.
items.explanationEn: disappear /ˌdɪs.əˈpɪər/ (verb): vanished, could no longer be seen. Here: rows silently filtered out without any error.

items.question: Trong câu "A manager rarely wants one number.", từ "rarely" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A manager rarely wants one number.", what does "rarely" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: rarely /ˈreə.li/ (trạng từ): hiếm khi. Đồng nghĩa với "seldom"; ngược với "often".
items.explanationEn: rarely /ˈreə.li/ (adverb): not often. Same as "seldom"; the opposite of "often".

items.question: Trong câu "Three decisions hide in that query, and each one changes the number:", từ "hide" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Three decisions hide in that query, and each one changes the number:", what does "hide" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hide /haɪd/ (động từ): ẩn, nằm khuất bên trong. Danh từ "hide" còn nghĩa là "da thú". "Hidden" = bị ẩn.
items.explanationEn: hide /haɪd/ (verb): be concealed inside. As a noun, "hide" also means an animal skin. "Hidden" = concealed.

items.question: Trong câu "A pending payment has no outcome yet, so it should not count as a failure.", từ "outcome" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A pending payment has no outcome yet, so it should not count as a failure.", what does "outcome" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (danh từ): kết quả cuối cùng. Hay dùng: "the outcome of a payment / a test".
items.explanationEn: outcome /ˈaʊt.kʌm/ (noun): the final result. Common: "the outcome of a payment / a test".

items.question: Trong câu "Which statuses count as success, and which rows belong in the denominator, are business decisions.", từ "denominator" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Which statuses count as success, and which rows belong in the denominator, are business decisions.", what does "denominator" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: the number below the line, the "out of how many"
the face value of a banknote
items.explanation: denominator /dɪˈnɒm.ɪ.neɪ.tər/ (danh từ): mẫu số. Ngược với "numerator" (tử số). "Common denominator" = điểm chung.
items.explanationEn: denominator /dɪˈnɒm.ɪ.neɪ.tər/ (noun): the number below the line, the "out of how many". The opposite of "numerator". "Common denominator" also means something shared.

items.question: Trong câu "The shortcut is handy for exploring.", từ "handy" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The shortcut is handy for exploring.", what does "handy" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: handy /ˈhæn.di/ (tính từ): tiện, hữu ích. "Come in handy" = trở nên hữu ích.
items.explanationEn: handy /ˈhæn.di/ (adjective): convenient and useful. "Come in handy" = turn out to be useful.

items.question: Trong câu "That difference is information, not an error: keep it in mind whenever you average or count a column.", từ "average" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That difference is information, not an error: keep it in mind whenever you average or count a column.", what does "average" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: average /ˈæv.ər.ɪdʒ/ (động từ): tính trung bình. Là động từ ở đây; danh từ/tính từ "average" = mức trung bình, bình thường.
items.explanationEn: average /ˈæv.ər.ɪdʒ/ (verb): calculate the mean of. A verb here; as a noun or adjective "average" means the typical level.

items.question: Trong câu "Multiplying by `100.0` (or `1.0`) first turns it into a decimal.", từ "decimal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Multiplying by `100.0` (or `1.0`) first turns it into a decimal.", what does "decimal" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a number with a fractional part
items.explanation: decimal /ˈdes.ɪ.məl/ (danh từ): số thập phân. "Decimal point" = dấu thập phân. Ngược với "integer".
items.explanationEn: decimal /ˈdes.ɪ.məl/ (noun): a number with a fractional part. "Decimal point" is the dot. The opposite of "integer".

items.question: Trong câu "A partial bucket must be labelled, dropped, or compared per day, never put on a chart next to full weeks without a note.", từ "partial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A partial bucket must be labelled, dropped, or compared per day, never put on a chart next to full weeks without a note.", what does "partial" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: partial /ˈpɑː.ʃəl/ (tính từ): chưa đầy đủ, một phần. Một nghĩa khác: "partial to" = thiên vị, thích.
items.explanationEn: partial /ˈpɑː.ʃəl/ (adjective): incomplete, only part. Another sense: "partial to" = fond of, biased toward.

items.question: Trong câu "A partial bucket must be labelled, dropped, or compared per day, never put on a chart next to full weeks without a note.", từ "label" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A partial bucket must be labelled, dropped, or compared per day, never put on a chart next to full weeks without a note.", what does "label" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: mark with a note or tag
items.explanation: label /ˈleɪ.bəl/ (động từ): ghi chú, gắn nhãn. Danh từ "label" = nhãn; "record label" = hãng đĩa.
items.explanationEn: label /ˈleɪ.bəl/ (verb): mark with a note or tag. As a noun, a label is a tag; "record label" = a music company.

items.question: Trong câu "Weekly buckets for June 2026 (VN time) show a classic trap:", từ "classic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Weekly buckets for June 2026 (VN time) show a classic trap:", what does "classic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: classic /ˈklæs.ɪk/ (tính từ): điển hình, kinh điển. Khác với "classical" (cổ điển, như nhạc cổ điển).
items.explanationEn: classic /ˈklæs.ɪk/ (adjective): typical, well known. Different from "classical" (as in classical music).

items.question: Trong câu "Other databases spell this differently: `DATE_TRUNC` in PostgreSQL and BigQuery, `DATE_FORMAT` in MySQL.", từ "spell" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Other databases spell this differently: `DATE_TRUNC` in PostgreSQL and BigQuery, `DATE_FORMAT` in MySQL.", what does "spell" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: spell /spel/ (động từ): viết, đánh vần. Danh từ "spell" còn nghĩa là "bùa phép" hoặc "một khoảng thời gian".
items.explanationEn: spell /spel/ (verb): write out, express in letters. As a noun, a spell is a magic charm or a period of time.

items.question: Trong câu "That last finding is itself useful: it is a product rule showing up in the data.", từ "finding" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That last finding is itself useful: it is a product rule showing up in the data.", what does "finding" (noun) mean?
options: phát hiện, kết luận rút ra
items.explanation: finding /ˈfaɪn.dɪŋ/ (danh từ): phát hiện, kết luận rút ra. Hay dùng ở dạng số nhiều: "key findings" = các phát hiện chính.
items.explanationEn: finding /ˈfaɪn.dɪŋ/ (noun): something discovered by analysis. Often plural: "key findings".

items.question: Trong câu "That last finding is itself useful: it is a product rule showing up in the data.", từ "show up" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That last finding is itself useful: it is a product rule showing up in the data.", what does "show up" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: show up /ʃəʊ ʌp/ (cụm từ): xuất hiện, hiện ra. Nghĩa khác: "show someone up" = làm ai bẽ mặt.
items.explanationEn: show up /ʃəʊ ʌp/ (phrase): appear, become visible. Another sense: "show someone up" = embarrass them.

items.question: Trong câu "For customers without a wallet, `w.status` is NULL, and `NULL = 'active'` is not true, so `WHERE` throws them away.", từ "throw away" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For customers without a wallet, `w.status` is NULL, and `NULL = 'active'` is not true, so `WHERE` throws them away.", what does "throw away" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: throw away /θrəʊ əˈweɪ/ (cụm từ): loại bỏ, vứt đi. Liên quan đến tính từ "throwaway" (dùng một lần).
items.explanationEn: throw away /θrəʊ əˈweɪ/ (phrase): discard, get rid of. Related to the adjective "throwaway".

items.question: Trong câu "This is the most common way analysts publish a wrong number.", từ "publish" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "This is the most common way analysts publish a wrong number.", what does "publish" (verb) mean?
options: công bố, đưa ra cho người khác
items.explanation: publish /ˈpʌb.lɪʃ/ (động từ): công bố, đưa ra cho người khác. Nghĩa gốc là xuất bản sách; trong công việc là công bố báo cáo, số liệu.
items.explanationEn: publish /ˈpʌb.lɪʃ/ (verb): release for others to see. Originally to print a book; at work, to release a report or figure.

items.question: Trong câu "One loan has many installments.", từ "installment" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "One loan has many installments.", what does "installment" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: one of the regular partial payments
items.explanation: installment /ɪnˈstɔːl.mənt/ (danh từ): kỳ trả góp. Anh-Anh viết "instalment". "Pay in installments" = trả góp.
items.explanationEn: installment /ɪnˈstɔːl.mənt/ (noun): one of the regular partial payments. British spelling "instalment". "Pay in installments" = pay bit by bit.

items.question: Trong câu "Now principal per product adds up to 34,040,900,000, matching `loans` alone.", từ "principal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Now principal per product adds up to 34,040,900,000, matching `loans` alone.", what does "principal" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: principal /ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (danh từ): tiền gốc của khoản vay. Cùng chữ, nghĩa khác: "principal" = hiệu trưởng. Đừng nhầm với "principle" (nguyên tắc).
items.explanationEn: principal /ˈprɪn.sə.pəl/ (noun): the original sum lent. Same word, another sense: a school head. Do not confuse with "principle".

items.question: Trong câu "Now principal per product adds up to 34,040,900,000, matching `loans` alone.", từ "add up to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Now principal per product adds up to 34,040,900,000, matching `loans` alone.", what does "add up to" (phrase) mean?
options: cộng lại thành, tổng cộng là
items.explanation: add up to /æd ʌp tuː/ (cụm từ): cộng lại thành, tổng cộng là. "It doesn't add up" = nghe không hợp lý.
items.explanationEn: add up to /æd ʌp tuː/ (phrase): total, come to. "It doesn't add up" = it does not make sense.

items.question: Trong câu "The joined figure is about 11.6 times the real loan book: a report would claim around 395 billion VND lent when the true figure is about 34 billion.", từ "loan book" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The joined figure is about 11.6 times the real loan book: a report would claim around 395 billion VND lent when the true figure is about 34 billion.", what does "loan book" (noun) mean?
options: sổ tay ghi chép khoản vay
danh mục cho vay, tổng dư nợ
optionsEn: the whole portfolio of loans a lender holds
items.explanation: loan book /ləʊn bʊk/ (danh từ): danh mục cho vay, tổng dư nợ. Còn gọi là "loan portfolio".
items.explanationEn: loan book /ləʊn bʊk/ (noun): the whole portfolio of loans a lender holds. Also called the "loan portfolio".

items.question: Trong câu "The joined figure is about 11.6 times the real loan book: a report would claim around 395 billion VND lent when the true figure is about 34 billion.", từ "claim" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The joined figure is about 11.6 times the real loan book: a report would claim around 395 billion VND lent when the true figure is about 34 billion.", what does "claim" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: claim /kleɪm/ (động từ): tuyên bố, khẳng định. Nghĩa khác: "claim" = yêu cầu bồi thường (insurance claim).
items.explanationEn: claim /kleɪm/ (verb): state that something is true. Another sense: an insurance claim.

items.question: Trong câu "Other defences:", từ "defence" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Other defences:", what does "defence" (noun) mean?
options: cách phòng thủ, biện pháp phòng ngừa
optionsEn: a way to protect against a problem
items.explanation: defence /dɪˈfens/ (danh từ): cách phòng thủ, biện pháp phòng ngừa. Anh-Mỹ viết "defense". Nghĩa pháp lý: lời bào chữa.
items.explanationEn: defence /dɪˈfens/ (noun): a way to protect against a problem. American spelling "defense". Legal sense: a case in court.

items.question: Trong câu "Aggregate each one in its own step, then join the summaries.", từ "aggregate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Aggregate each one in its own step, then join the summaries.", what does "aggregate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: aggregate /ˈæɡ.rɪ.ɡeɪt/ (động từ): tổng hợp, gộp lại. Danh từ "aggregate" = tổng thể; "aggregation" = phép tổng hợp.
items.explanationEn: aggregate /ˈæɡ.rɪ.ɡeɪt/ (verb): combine into totals. As a noun, the total; "aggregation" = the act of combining.

items.question: Trong câu "Long analytical queries become readable when you split them into named steps.", từ "readable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Long analytical queries become readable when you split them into named steps.", what does "readable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: readable /ˈriː.də.bəl/ (tính từ): dễ đọc, dễ hiểu. Khác với "read-only" (chỉ đọc).
items.explanationEn: readable /ˈriː.də.bəl/ (adjective): easy to read and follow. Different from "read-only".

items.question: Trong câu "Long analytical queries become readable when you split them into named steps.", từ "split" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Long analytical queries become readable when you split them into named steps.", what does "split" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: split /splɪt/ (động từ): chia, tách ra. "Split the bill" = chia hóa đơn.
items.explanationEn: split /splɪt/ (verb): divide into parts. "Split the bill" = share the cost.

items.question: Trong câu "A colleague reads three small steps instead of one nested block.", từ "nested" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A colleague reads three small steps instead of one nested block.", what does "nested" (adjective) mean?
options: lồng nhau, nằm bên trong nhau
items.explanation: nested /ˈnes.tɪd/ (tính từ): lồng nhau, nằm bên trong nhau. Từ "nest" (tổ chim). "Nested query" = query lồng.
items.explanationEn: nested /ˈnes.tɪd/ (adjective): placed one inside another. From "nest". "Nested query" = a query inside a query.

items.question: Trong câu "If you write the definition first, the query almost writes itself, and the developer who builds the dashboard can check their query against yours step by step.", từ "step by step" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you write the definition first, the query almost writes itself, and the developer who builds the dashboard can check their query against yours step by step.", what does "step by step" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: step by step /step baɪ step/ (cụm từ): từng bước một. Hay dùng làm tính từ: "a step-by-step guide".
items.explanationEn: step by step /step baɪ step/ (phrase): one stage at a time. Often an adjective: "a step-by-step guide".

items.explanationEn: survive /səˈvaɪv/ (verb): remain, not be removed. Literal sense: stay alive. Here: rows that pass the filter.

items.question: Trong câu "These checks take a minute each and catch most mistakes:", từ "catch" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?

items.explanationEn: uniqueness /juːˈniːk.nəs/ (noun): being the only one, no duplicates. In data: each key appears only once.
